name: FLARE challenge
description: Benchmarks fast, low-GPU-memory algorithms for abdomen CT organ segmentation under constrained resources.
evaluation_method: F1 (Dice coefficient), with auxiliary Hausdorff distance reporting
reputation: A well-known medical imaging challenge (FLARE) focused on fast, low-memory abdominal CT organ segmentation with active participation from the medical image analysis community.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; evaluates resource-constrained inference and memory usage. Scores can vary significantly by organ (class imbalance) and may saturate for large organs; dataset size and benchmark rules (e.g., memory limits) can influence comparability across methods.
